# Pharmacy Commons REST API Specification\\n\\n**Version:** 1.0  \\n**Status:** Ready for deployment  \\n**Generated by:** Agent \#3 \- API Route Generator  \\n**Date:** 2026\-09\-08  \\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# Overview\\n\\nThe Pharmacy Commons API provides RESTful access to the drug information database via Supabase PostgREST and stored functions. All endpoints return JSON responses and use PCID (Pharmacy Commons ID) as the primary drug identifier.\\n\\n\#\#\# Base URL\\n\\n`\nhttps://nenwovhyrdcdkhxzjiiv.supabase.co/rest/v1\n`\\n\\n\#\#\# Authentication\\n\\n\- **Public endpoints:** Use `Authorization: Bearer <ANON_KEY>` header\\n\- **Anon Key:** `eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Im5lbndvdmh5cmRjZGtoeHpqaWl2Iiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODgyMDc1NzcsImV4cCI6MjEwMzc4MzU3N30.gDxL9yx88AWPgwuPlDNv879VhpNHLQMFfmaqDwed30I`\\n\- **All read operations are public** (via RLS policies)\\n\- **Write operations** require authentication \+ moderation workflow\\n\\n\#\#\# Identifier Scheme\\n\\n**PCID** (Pharmacy Commons ID) is the canonical drug entity identifier:\\n\- Format: `PCID-NNNNNNN` (7\-digit deterministic code)\\n\- Example: `PCID-1234567`\\n\- Generated via SHA\-256 hash of drug name (first 7 hex chars → decimal)\\n\- Immutable; same drug always maps to same PCID\\n\\n**Slug** is the URL\-friendly identifier:\\n\- Format: lowercase alphanumeric \+ hyphens only\\n\- Example: `metformin`, `ibuprofen-lysine`\\n\- Resolves to PCID via `pcid` table lookup\\n\- Frontend URLs use slugs; backend resolves to PCID\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# Endpoints\\n\\n\#\#\# 1. GET /rpc/get\_drug\_by\_slug\\n\\nFetch complete drug detail by URL slug.\\n\\n**Request:**\\n`http\nGET /rpc/get_drug_by_slug?p_slug=metformin HTTP/1.1\nHost: nenwovhyrdcdkhxzjiiv.supabase.co\nAuthorization: Bearer <ANON_KEY>\n`\\n\\n**Query Parameters:**\\n\- `p_slug` (string, required): Drug slug (e.g., `metformin`)\\n\\n**Response (200 OK):**\\n`json\n{\n  \"pcid_code\": \"PCID-1234567\",\n  \"name\": \"Metformin\",\n  \"slug\": \"metformin\",\n  \"display_name\": null,\n  \"description\": \"Second-line antidiabetic...\",\n  \"entity_type\": \"drug\",\n  \"status\": \"active\",\n  \"attributes\": {\n    \"salt_form\": [\"hydrochloride\"],\n    \"strength\": [\"500 mg\", \"850 mg\", \"1000 mg\"],\n    \"form\": [\"tablet\", \"extended-release tablet\"],\n    \"manufacturer\": [\"Bristol-Myers Squibb\", \"Bausch Health\"]\n  },\n  \"components\": [],\n  \"interactions\": [\n    {\n      \"other_pcid_id\": 98765,\n      \"other_drug_name\": \"Iodinated Contrast Media\",\n      \"other_drug_slug\": \"iodinated-contrast-media\",\n      \"severity\": \"major\",\n      \"mechanism\": \"Temporary renal impairment increases risk of lactic acidosis\",\n      \"clinical_effect\": \"Avoid concomitant use or monitor renal function closely\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eco_risk\": {\n    \"rq_value\": 52.5,\n    \"rq_category\": \"high\",\n    \"pec_value\": 2.1,\n    \"pec_unit\": \"μg/L\",\n    \"mec_value\": 0.04,\n    \"mec_unit\": \"μg/L\",\n    \"dpd_category\": \"high\",\n    \"dpd_days\": 45,\n    \"excretion_route\": \"renal\",\n    \"primary_concern\": \"Aquatic invertebrates and fish endocrine disruption; widespread contamination of surface water and groundwater\",\n    \"detailed_notes\": \"Metformin is among the most frequently detected pharmaceuticals in global waterways...\"\n  },\n  \"fda_ndc_codes\": [\"49483-0110-01\", \"49483-0110-10\"],\n  \"fda_application_number\": \"NDA-012621\",\n  \"fda_last_updated\": \"2026-08-15T10:30:00Z\",\n  \"created_at\": \"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z\",\n  \"updated_at\": \"2026-09-08T02:53:44Z\"\n}\n`\\n\\n**Response (404 Not Found):**\\n`json\n{\n  \"error\": true,\n  \"code\": \"NOT_FOUND\",\n  \"message\": \"Drug with slug 'unknown-drug' not found\"\n}\n`\\n\\n**Notes:**\\n\- Returns complete drug with all relationships\\n\- Attributes flattened into single object for API efficiency\\n\- Use `other_drug_slug` field to navigate related drugs\\n\- Eco metrics are denormalized for single\-call efficiency\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\#\# 2. GET /rpc/get\_drug\_by\_pcid\\n\\nFetch complete drug detail by PCID (direct lookup).\\n\\n**Request:**\\n`http\nGET /rpc/get_drug_by_pcid?p_pcid_code=PCID-1234567 HTTP/1.1\nHost: nenwovhyrdcdkhxzjiiv.supabase.co\nAuthorization: Bearer <ANON_KEY>\n`\\n\\n**Query Parameters:**\\n\- `p_pcid_code` (string, required): Drug PCID (e.g., `PCID-1234567`)\\n\\n**Response:**\\nIdentical to `get_drug_by_slug`; see above.\\n\\n**Notes:**\\n\- Use when you already have PCID (internal navigation)\\n\- Slightly faster than slug lookup (no join)\\n\- Recommended for component/interaction navigation\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\#\# 3. GET /rpc/list\_drugs\_paginated\\n\\nList drugs with pagination and optional filtering.\\n\\n**Request:**\\n`http\nGET /rpc/list_drugs_paginated?p_limit=25&p_offset=0&p_entity_type=drug HTTP/1.1\nHost: nenwovhyrdcdkhxzjiiv.supabase.co\nAuthorization: Bearer <ANON_KEY>\n`\\n\\n**Query Parameters:**\\n\- `p_limit` (integer, optional): Results per page; default 25, max 100\\n\- `p_offset` (integer, optional): Starting position; default 0\\n\- `p_entity_type` (string, optional): Filter by type (`drug`, `substance`, `combination`, `device`); null \= all types\\n\\n**Response (200 OK):**\\n`json\n{\n  \"drugs\": [\n    {\n      \"pcid_code\": \"PCID-1234567\",\n      \"name\": \"Metformin\",\n      \"slug\": \"metformin\",\n      \"display_name\": null,\n      \"entity_type\": \"drug\",\n      \"fda_ndc_codes\": [\"49483-0110-01\"],\n      \"rq_category\": \"high\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pcid_code\": \"PCID-2345678\",\n      \"name\": \"Sertraline\",\n      \"slug\": \"sertraline\",\n      \"display_name\": null,\n      \"entity_type\": \"drug\",\n      \"fda_ndc_codes\": [\"50458-0545-01\"],\n      \"rq_category\": \"moderate\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"total_count\": 23,\n  \"limit\": 25,\n  \"offset\": 0,\n  \"has_more\": false,\n  \"next_offset\": null\n}\n`\\n\\n**Notes:**\\n\- Returns minimal drug entries (list items, not full details)\\n\- Use `next_offset` for pagination (or increment `offset` by `limit`)\\n\- `has_more` indicates if additional pages exist\\n\- Filter by `p_entity_type` to reduce results (e.g., only drugs, not substances)\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\#\# 4. GET /rpc/search\_drugs\\n\\nFull\-text search by drug name, slug, or attributes.\\n\\n**Request:**\\n`http\nGET /rpc/search_drugs?p_query=sert&p_limit=25&p_offset=0 HTTP/1.1\nHost: nenwovhyrdcdkhxzjiiv.supabase.co\nAuthorization: Bearer <ANON_KEY>\n`\\n\\n**Query Parameters:**\\n\- `p_query` (string, required): Search term (prefix matching on name/slug)\\n\- `p_limit` (integer, optional): Results per page; default 25, max 100\\n\- `p_offset` (integer, optional): Starting position; default 0\\n\\n**Response (200 OK):**\\n`json\n{\n  \"query\": \"sert\",\n  \"results\": [\n    {\n      \"pcid_code\": \"PCID-2345678\",\n      \"name\": \"Sertraline\",\n      \"slug\": \"sertraline\",\n      \"display_name\": null,\n      \"entity_type\": \"drug\",\n      \"fda_ndc_codes\": [\"50458-0545-01\"],\n      \"rq_category\": \"moderate\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"total_count\": 1,\n  \"limit\": 25,\n  \"offset\": 0,\n  \"has_more\": false\n}\n`\\n\\n**Error Response (400 Bad Request):**\\n`json\n{\n  \"error\": true,\n  \"code\": \"INVALID_QUERY\",\n  \"message\": \"Search query cannot be empty\"\n}\n`\\n\\n**Notes:**\\n\- Matches drug names, slugs, and attributes (salt forms, manufacturers, etc.)\\n\- Prefix matching: `sert` matches `Sertraline` but not `INSERT`\\n\- Case\-insensitive\\n\- Results ranked by relevance (name \> slug \> attributes)\\n\- Minimum query length: 1 character\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# Data Structures\\n\\n\#\#\# DrugDetail\\n\\nComplete drug entity with all relationships.\\n\\n**Fields:**\\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\\n|\-\-\-\-\-\-\-|\-\-\-\-\-\-|\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-|\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-|\\n| `pcid_code` | string | Yes | Primary identifier (PCID\-NNNNNNN) |\\n| `name` | string | Yes | INN name (e.g., 'Metformin') |\\n| `slug` | string | Yes | URL\-friendly slug |\\n| `display_name` | string \\| null | No | Brand/common name |\\n| `description` | string \\| null | No | Drug monograph excerpt |\\n| `entity_type` | enum | Yes | 'drug', 'substance', 'combination', 'device' |\\n| `status` | enum | Yes | 'active', 'archived', 'pending', 'draft' |\\n| `attributes` | object | Yes | Flattened attributes (salts, forms, strengths, etc.) |\\n| `components` | array | Yes | Component drugs (empty for non\-combination) |\\n| `interactions` | array | Yes | Drug\-to\-drug interactions |\\n| `eco_risk` | object | Yes | Environmental risk metrics |\\n| `fda_ndc_codes` | array \\| null | No | NDC codes |\\n| `fda_application_number` | string \\| null | No | NDA/ANDA number |\\n| `fda_last_updated` | string \\| null | No | ISO 8601 timestamp |\\n| `created_at` | string | Yes | ISO 8601 timestamp |\\n| `updated_at` | string | Yes | ISO 8601 timestamp |\\n\\n\#\#\# `component_pcid_id` | integer | Yes | PCID of component drug |\\n| `component_name` | string | Yes | INN name (denormalized) |\\n| `component_slug` | string | Yes | Slug (for linking) |\\n| `role` | `other_pcid_id` | integer | Yes | PCID of interacting drug |\\n| `other_drug_name` | string | Yes | INN name (denormalized) |\\n| `other_drug_slug` | string | Yes | Slug (for linking) |\\n| `severity` | enum | Yes | 'minor', 'moderate', 'major' |\\n| `mechanism` | string \\| null | No | How the interaction works |\\n| `clinical_effect` | string \\| null | No | Clinical consequence |\\n\\n\#\#\# No | 'renal', 'biliary', 'metabolic', 'mixed' |\\n| `primary_concern` | string \\| null | No | Summary of environmental risk |\\n| `detailed_notes` | string \\| null | No | Full assessment |\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# Error Handling\\n\\nAll errors return a consistent JSON response:\\n\\n`json\n{\n  \"error\": true,\n  \"code\": \"ERROR_CODE\",\n  \"message\": \"Human-readable description\",\n  \"details\": {}\n}\n`\\n\\n**Common Error Codes:**\\n\\n| Code | HTTP | Description |\\n|\-\-\-\-\-\-|\-\-\-\-\-\-|\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-|\\n| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Drug or resource not found |\\n| `INVALID_QUERY` | 400 | Invalid query parameters |\\n| `SERVER_ERROR` | 500 | Unhandled server error |\\n| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | Too many requests |\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# Rate Limiting\\n\\n\- **Limit:** 3,500 requests/minute (Supabase default)\\n\- **Header:** `X-RateLimit-Remaining` in response\\n\- **Backoff:** If rate limited, wait 60 seconds before retrying\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# Caching\\n\\nThe frontend API client implements automatic slug→PCID caching:\\n\- **In\-memory cache** reduces repeated lookups\\n\- **Cache size:** Unbounded (clear manually if needed)\\n\- **Hit rate:** Expected \>80% for typical user sessions\\n\\n**Cache invalidation:** Automatic on update (future feature, requires auth)\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# Slug Resolution Flow\\n\\n**Typical user journey:**\\n\\n1. User navigates to `/drugs/metformin`\\n2. Frontend calls `resolveSlugToPcid('metformin')`\\n3. Cache hit → returns PCID immediately (fast path)\\n4. Or cache miss → queries Supabase `SELECT pcid_code FROM pcid WHERE slug = 'metformin'`\\n5. Frontend calls `get_drug_by_pcid(PCID)` via stored function\\n6. Stored function returns complete drug detail (single database call)\\n7. Component renders full drug page\\n\\n**Benefits:**\\n\- URLs remain human\-readable (slugs, not PCIDs)\\n\- Backend resolved identifiers transparent to users\\n\- Single query per page load (after slug resolution)\\n\- Bidirectional lookup for component/interaction navigation\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# TypeScript Integration\\n\\nThe frontend uses auto\-generated TypeScript types (`src/api.generated.ts`):\\n\\n``typescript\nimport type { DrugDetail, DrugListResponse } from '@/api.generated'\nimport { getDrugBySlug, listDrugs, searchDrugs } from '@/api'\n\n// Fetch drug\nconst drug: DrugDetail | null = await getDrugBySlug('metformin')\n\n// Type-safe interactions loop\nif (drug?.interactions) {\n  drug.interactions.forEach(interaction => {\n    console.log(`${interaction.other_drug_name}: ${interaction.severity}`)\n  })\n}\n``\\n\\nAll API responses are fully typed; no `any` types.\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# Deployment Checklist\\n\\n\- ✅ Supabase schema deployed (PCID\-based)\\n\- ✅ RLS policies enabled (public read)\\n\- ✅ Stored functions deployed\\n\- ✅ Slug index created\\n\- ✅ 23\+ drugs loaded in `pcid` table\\n\- ✅ FDA NDC codes and metadata populated\\n\- ✅ Interaction relationships linked\\n\- ✅ Eco metrics calculated\\n\- ⏳ Frontend integrated (in progress)\\n\- ⏳ Integration tests passing (in progress)\\n\- ⏳ GitHub Pages 404 redirect deployed (in progress)\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# Example Queries\\n\\n\#\#\# Fetch a single drug\\n\\n`bash\ncurl -X GET 'https://nenwovhyrdcdkhxzjiiv.supabase.co/rest/v1/rpc/get_drug_by_slug?p_slug=metformin' \\\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...'\n`\\n\\n\#\#\# List first 10 drugs\\n\\n`bash\ncurl -X GET 'https://nenwovhyrdcdkhxzjiiv.supabase.co/rest/v1/rpc/list_drugs_paginated?p_limit=10&p_offset=0' \\\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...'\n`\\n\\n\#\#\# Search for drugs starting with "ser"\\n\\n`bash\ncurl -X GET 'https://nenwovhyrdcdkhxzjiiv.supabase.co/rest/v1/rpc/search_drugs?p_query=ser&p_limit=25' \\\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...'\n`\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n\#\# OpenAPI/Swagger (Future)\\n\\nOpenAPI 3.0 specification available at `/docs/openapi.yaml` (to be generated).\\n\\n\-\-\-\\n\\n**API Version:** 1.0  \\n**Last Updated:** 2026\-09\-08  \\n**License:** GPL\-3.0 (codebase), Creative Commons (data)  \\n"
